name: firefox-duplicate-scout
description: Firefox extension to analyze duplicate tabs and bookmarks locally, group/mark duplicates, and generate detailed reports.

scripts.firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.webext:lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.package:xpi: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run webext:lint
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts
scripts.package:overwrite: npm run build && web-ext build --overwrite-dest --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts
